subject: Onboarding needs in Profile v2 + calibration summary
body: Onboarding builds against your Profile v2 fixture. Please include: (1) per emotion a leverage line (one sentence, why it matters) and ownWords (their description of the moment); (2) per strategy slot an action plus an if-then situation cue (already in mvp.md); (3) an optional anchor {kind: sound|gesture|word, value}; (4) a CalibrationSummary shape on emotion.calibration that sensing.record() returns: e.g. source, seconds, hrMean, hrSd, rmssd, quality, plus the person's 0-10 rating I add; (5) the result of onboarding.run() when the person stops for safety or cancels (a stopped status rather than a Profile?). Unconfirmed slots: do you want null, or omit and a per-slot confirmed flag? I'll use your validator in the M2 extractor.
